WITH items AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS amt,
         COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM olist_order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
), pay AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM olist_order_payments
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.amt), 2) AS total_with_freight,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_cnt
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN pay p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(price+freight_value),2) FROM olist_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) AS item_amt,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) AS item_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_order_payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id) AS pay_rows
FROM olist_orders o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
ORDER BY o.order_id
